name: voltaic-sphere-deals-five-to-an-ally
notes: Voltaic Sphere: 5 damage to an ally (3 to other units). Pre-fix the body only offered allies and read the target as an array.

rulesClauses: Deal 3 damage to target unit. If that unit is an ally, deal 5 damage to it instead.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated body only offered allies, dealt 3 to phantasias and 5 to everything else, and could not target champions; overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.
